offering_description.value: Armstrong manufactures acoustic ceiling systems for commercial and institutional buildings and sells ceiling tiles for homes. It also makes standard and custom architectural ceilings and wall panels, selling through building-material distributors, home improvement retailers and direct project sales.

primary_products.value: Mineral fiber ceiling tiles; fiberglass ceiling panels; metal ceiling and wall systems; wood ceiling and wall systems; acoustic felt panels and baffles

primary_services.value: Architectural design and specification assistance; custom ceiling and wall system engineering

customer_segment.value: B2B: Building-material distributors, ceiling contractors, commercial property owners and home improvement retailers; B2C: Homeowners buying ceiling tiles for renovations or replacement

end_markets.value: Commercial offices; education; healthcare; retail; residential remodeling

revenue_model.value: product sales: Standard ceiling tiles and panels, plus custom architectural ceiling and wall systems

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Turns mineral fibers, metal, wood and felt into ceiling and wall systems for distributors, contractors and retailers

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada

specialization.value: related lines: Acoustic ceiling tiles, specialty ceilings and architectural wall panels

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Building-material distributors serving ceiling contractors; direct sales: Contractors and commercial accounts purchasing custom architectural systems; third-party retail: Home improvement retailers carrying residential ceiling tiles; online: Company-operated storefront for ceiling tiles and replacement panels
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; direct sales; third-party retail; online

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Environmental and workplace safety rules for manufacturing, plus building and fire code requirements for installed products

notes: It is unclear whether Armstrong sells any standalone services as a primary offering.

gap_fill.notes: Separate billing for design and engineering services is unconfirmed.
